title: The Whispering Pines
story: Ancient roots block the winding woodland trail. Enchanted numbers glow on the wooden bark.
objective: Answer 5 addition problems to clear the fallen logs from the forest path.
characterDialogue: Watch out! The fallen timber won't budge until we calculate their combined weight!

title: River of Subtraction
story: A rushing stream of sparkling water cuts through the forest. Stepping stones lie scattered along the bank.
objective: Subtract the stones from the riverbed to build a safe crossing bridge.
characterDialogue: Careful where you step! Subtract the difference between each boulder to find the stable rocks.

title: Multiply the Acorns
story: A tribe of friendly forest squirrels needs help organizing winter supplies before sundown.
objective: Solve 5 multiplication puzzles to calculate equal acorn bundles.
characterDialogue: Chirp chirp! Can you help us group our acorns into equal baskets?

title: Find the Golden Key
story: A giant moss-covered iron gate blocks the entrance to the inner grove. Five lock tumblers click in sequence.
objective: Solve division challenges to reveal the Golden Key and unlock the gate.
characterDialogue: The ancient lock requires equal sharing! Divide each lock code evenly to turn the key.

title: The Enchanted Glade
story: Glowing mushrooms illuminate a clearing where number runes pulse with ancient magic.
objective: Complete 5 mixed arithmetic operations to charge the gateway portal.
characterDialogue: The forest magic is building! Combine all four operations to awaken the guardian portal.

title: Boss: Sylva, Forest Goblin King
story: Sylva the Goblin King emerges from the hollow oak, wielding a spiked number club and guarding the exit!
objective: Deplete Sylva's 100 HP challenge meter with correct math calculations to unlock Fraction Kingdom!
characterDialogue: Gwahaha! No adventurer leaves my forest without paying the math toll! Let's see your arithmetic!

title: The Royal Pizzeria
story: Enter the floating citadel where chefs prepare royal pizzas cut into fractional slices.
objective: Identify numerators and denominators to serve correct fraction portions.
characterDialogue: Welcome to the Royal Bakery! Remember: the bottom number counts all slices, the top counts what we serve!

title: The Decimal Drawbridge
story: The golden drawbridge is weighed down by heavy counterweights marked in tenths and hundredths.
objective: Calculate decimal place values and money sums to balance the bridge.
characterDialogue: Watch the decimal point! 0.5 is half a rupee, and 0.25 is a quarter!

title: Tower of Equivalent Fractions
story: Spiral staircases wind upwards, but steps only appear when matching equivalent fractions.
objective: Identify equivalent fractions like 1/2, 2/4, and 4/8 to ascend the tower.
characterDialogue: Different numbers, same value! Multiply both top and bottom by the same magic factor!

title: Adding Like Portions
story: The royal feast requires mixing potions with like denominators.
objective: Add and subtract fractions with identical denominators.
characterDialogue: When denominators match, simply combine the top numerators together!

title: The Market of Decimals
story: Merchants in the kingdom square trade jewels and ribbons measured in decimal lengths.
objective: Solve word problems combining decimals and measurements.
characterDialogue: Align your decimals by the dot and add columns from right to left!

title: Boss: King Fractionicus & Pizza Golem
story: King Fractionicus sits atop an animated Pizza Golem made of bubbling cheese and crust shields!
objective: Defeat the 120 HP Pizza Golem with fraction calculations to unlock the Desert of Numbers!
characterDialogue: You think you can divide and conquer my kingdom? Taste my Fraction Pepperoni Slam!

title: The Prime Mirage
story: Shimmering heat waves in the desert reveal mythical prime number monuments.
objective: Identify prime numbers that have exactly two factors: 1 and themselves.
characterDialogue: Only prime numbers hold true form in the mirage! 2 is the only even prime superhero!

title: Dunes of Multiples
story: Shifting sand dunes require jumping strictly on multiples of numbers to avoid sinking.
objective: Calculate multiples and skip-counting patterns to navigate the sands.
characterDialogue: Step on multiples of 6 and 9! Every stride multiplies your journey forward!

title: Tomb of Factors
story: Hieroglyphic doors seal the ancient sandstone pyramid. All factors must be entered to disarm traps.
objective: Find all factor pairs for two-digit numbers.
characterDialogue: A factor divides evenly with zero remainder. Check from 1 upward!

title: Oasis of HCF
story: Two underground springs feed the desert oasis. Find the Highest Common Factor to open the sluice gates.
objective: Calculate the HCF of pairs of numbers to fill the oasis reservoirs.
characterDialogue: Find the largest factor that divides both numbers evenly!

title: The LCM Caravan Route
story: Two trade caravans travel at different intervals. Predict when their routes will meet.
objective: Calculate the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM) for time synchronization.
characterDialogue: The LCM tells us the exact point when both cycles repeat together!

title: Boss: Scorpio, the Prime Sphinx
story: A giant stone Sphinx with scorpion armor rises from the dunes, posing mathematical riddles!
objective: Answer factor and multiple questions to shatter Scorpio's 140 HP stone armor!
characterDialogue: Mortal traveller! Solve the riddle of factors, or wander my sands forever!

title: Archipelago of Angles
story: Navigate your sailboat between jagged rocky islands classified by their angular slopes.
objective: Identify acute, right, obtuse, and straight angles to steer the ship safely.
characterDialogue: Square corners are 90° right angles! Sharper ones are acute, wider ones obtuse!

title: Perimeter Reef
story: A protective net must be laid along the outer boundary of the coral sanctuary.
objective: Calculate the perimeter of rectangles and squares: P = 2 × (l + w).
characterDialogue: Perimeter is the fence around the garden! Add all outer boundary lengths together!

title: Area of the Lost Galleon
story: Search the flat rectangular decks of sunken treasure ships for golden chests.
objective: Calculate area of rectangles and squares: Area = length × width.
characterDialogue: Area measures the flat space inside! Multiply length by width for square units!

title: The Triangle Trench
story: Triangular sonar pulses scan the ocean floor for hidden marine caverns.
objective: Use the triangle angle sum theorem (180°) and triangle area formulas.
characterDialogue: All three angles in any triangle always add up to 180° without exception!

title: Circle Lighthouse Beacon
story: The rotating lighthouse beam marks safe maritime channels with circular arcs.
objective: Calculate circle radius, diameter, and linear pairs.
characterDialogue: Diameter passes straight through the center and is twice the radius: d = 2r!

title: Boss: Kraken of the Angles
story: A titanic sea monster with tentacled geometric arms emerges from the whirlpool!
objective: Strike the Kraken's 160 HP with accurate geometry calculations to calm the seas!
characterDialogue: Release the angles! My tentacles strike at 90-degree angles! Can you calculate your survival?

title: Moat of Negative Integers
story: Volcanic magma moat where platforms float at elevations above and below zero.
objective: Solve integer addition and subtraction on the signed number line.
characterDialogue: Negative numbers drop below zero! Moving right adds, moving left subtracts!

title: Courtyard of Ratios
story: Statues hold balanced scales where weights must be mixed in exact mathematical proportions.
objective: Solve ratio simplification and unitary method problems.
characterDialogue: Find the value of 1 single unit first, then multiply by the required parts!

title: Tower of Fractions & Decimals
story: Ascend the spire by multiplying fractions and dividing decimal measurements.
objective: Multiply and divide fractions: Keep, Change, Flip!
characterDialogue: Keep the first fraction, Change division to times, and Flip the second upside down!

title: Vault of 3D Volumes
story: Open ancient cuboid chests by calculating their internal 3D volume capacity.
objective: Calculate volume of cuboids: V = length × width × height.
characterDialogue: 3D shapes have length, width, and height! Volume is measured in cubic units!

title: Hall of Mathematical Logic
story: The dragon's sanctum gates require solving multi-step mathematical application challenges.
objective: Synthesize multiple skills to unlock the Dragon's Throne.
characterDialogue: You stand before the final throne! Read carefully, identify the knowns, and conquer!

title: FINAL BOSS: Ignis, Dragon of Numbers
story: Ignis descends from the volcanic caldera, breathing mathematical fire! This is the ultimate test!
objective: Answer 5 epic mixed challenge questions to deplete Ignis's 200 HP and become Grand Math Champion!
characterDialogue: Roaaar! I am Ignis! For a thousand years no student has bested my calculations! Show me your true mastery!
